diagnosis.root_cause: The subscriber's CATV service is provisioned but the ONU reports catv_synced=0, so the TV/RF service is not synchronized. Internet service is unaffected and the EPON, authentication, VLAN, router, and OLT paths are healthy.
evidence: The complaint is specifically that Internet works but TV channels never came on.
The subscriber is online and the live ONU probe reports online=1, Auth, and exchange=Finish.
RX power is -20.4 dBm and TX power is 2.45 dBm, both within the calibrated healthy ranges.
The seven-day RX and TX telemetry is stable, distance is constant at 118, and TX bias remains healthy; there is no evidence of fibre, laser, or distance fault.
All tested peers on EPON0/7 are online, and the OLT responds to ping and SNMP with healthy CPU, memory, and temperature.
The router heartbeat is healthy and traffic is present, so the Internet path is functioning.
RADIUS exists and matches CRM, sessions are normal at two in 24 hours, and the expected customer VLAN 1037 is actually present; therefore authentication and VLAN faults are excluded.
The subscriber has CATV service enabled and a CATV-capable ONU, but catv_synced is 0, directly identifying a CATV synchronization/service fault.
There is no evidence that other customers are affected, so the scope is limited to this customer.

remediation.action: Check CATV optical/RF levels, coaxial drop, connectors, and ONU CATV input; attempt a CATV resynchronization or reprovision the CATV profile. If synchronization cannot be restored, replace the ONU or escalate the CATV plant/drop for RF inspection.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
